source.name: FC Dallas – 'FC Dallas Unveils New "DNA Kit" Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: UT Southwestern Medical Center remains the front-of-jersey partner for the Inferno Kit.

source.name: FC Dallas – 'FC Dallas Unveils New "DNA Kit" Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: Returning for 2026, the Apple TV sleeve patch appears on the left sleeve of both FC Dallas jerseys.

summary: The Inferno Kit continues as the club's secondary jersey for 2026-27, with UT Southwestern Medical Center on the front and the Apple TV league patch on the left sleeve.
